research_notes.finding: Pattern: Orama doesn't have built-in query caching. Cache at application layer using Map with TTL. Cache key: query text + filter options (JSON.stringify for consistency)
Pattern: Use useQuery hook with keepPreviousData for debounced results Cache invalidation: broadcastChannel or custom event for cross-tab sync
Finding: Implement query batching, result caching with TTL (5-10min default), LRU eviction for cache entries (max 100 entries), and relevance boosting for recency

architecture_patterns.pattern: Use singleton pattern with lazy initialization for query cache
Follow useDebouncedValue pattern from existing codebase
Extend existing rag-store with new state properties

technical_notes.note: Query cache must invalidate when sources change (insert/update/delete)
Cache TTL should be configurable (default 5 minutes = 300000ms)
Use performance.now() for query time measurement
Debounce delay of 300ms for search input
LRU eviction: remove oldest entries when cache exceeds 100 entries
